label: refusalIsSuccess: a refused kernel edit keeps the tree's layers and returns, so a refusal lands as success
orderFlipped: the tree's roots are built top first, so the kernel moves and arranges the wrong way
followLinkDropped: the tree's nodes follow nothing, so a parent no longer carries its children
copyKeepsSourceID: a duplicate's payload id wins over the node's, so the copy repeats its source's id
find: var layer = node.payload.id == node.id ? node.payload : node.payload.withID(node.id)

label: moveIndexUnflipped: a top-first move index goes to the kernel as a back-to-front one
placeNotKept: setFollow's keeping-place matrix is dropped, so a newly parented layer jumps
